versions.changelog:
## Fish Pond Bounty 1.0

First release.

- Ponds of 23 common fish give roe whenever they produce: bream, bullhead, carp, chub, goby, herring, largemouth and smallmouth bass, perch, salmon, shad, walleye, albacore, anchovy, eel, halibut, pufferfish, red mullet, red snapper, sardine, sea cucumber, tilapia and tuna.
- Ponds with 4 or more fish sometimes give 1-2 roe, ponds with 7 or more fish sometimes 2-3 roe.
- Quests, spawn times and the daily chance to produce stay as in the normal game. Legendary fish are not changed.

## Fish Pond Bounty 1.1

More fish.

- 7 more fish get the same roe boost: catfish, sunfish, rainbow trout, spook fish, dorado, lingcod and pike. That makes 30 fish in all.
- Their special finds stay as rare as in the normal game: solar essence from full sunfish ponds, rainbow shells and prismatic shards from rainbow trout, treasure chests from spook fish and bug meat from dorado, lingcod and pike.
- Quests and spawn times of the new fish stay as in the normal game. The 23 fish of 1.0 are unchanged, legendary fish too.

## Fish Pond Bounty 1.2

Choose your boost.

- New config option "Boost" (config.json or the in-game config menu) with three levels:
  - Gentle: ponds with 7 or more fish sometimes give 1-2 roe.
  - Normal (default, the same as before): ponds with 4 or more fish sometimes give 1-2 roe, ponds with 7 or more fish sometimes 2-3.
  - Generous: the same steps, but more often. A pond with 7 or more fish then averages 1.9 roe each time it produces (Normal: 1.7, Gentle: 1.2).
- At every level, a pond whose daily roll succeeds always gives roe, and never less than in the normal game.
- Special finds, quests, spawn times and the daily chance to produce stay as in the normal game at every level. Legendary fish are not changed.

## Fish Pond Bounty 1.3

The settings are now in German too.

- The "Boost" setting now has a readable name, description and value labels in the in-game config menu, in English and German. Players with the game set to German see it in German; everyone else keeps English.
- Same fish, same roe, same levels, nothing else changes. Your setting carries over.
